d:
Khula aakash | kala ke manch se aatmanirbharta | imli dasgupta | durdarshan bihar
Kala keval abhivyakti ka madhyam nahin, balki aatmanirbhar banne aur apni pahchan sthapit karne ka ek sashakt rasta bhi hai.
Karyakram ‘khula aakash’ ki is vishesh prastuti men janie imli dasgupta ke sath kala ke madhyam se aatmanirbharta ki prernadayak yatra. kaise kala hunar ko pahchan dilati hai, aatmavishvas barhati hai aur logon ko apne pairon par khare hone ka avsar pradan karti hai.
Dekhie kala, rachnatmakta aur aatmanirbharta se juri prerak baten, durdarshan bihar ke vishesh karyakram ‘khula aakash’ men.
